question: Within the qualified R8 interval from 96 to 112 independent observations per raw surface, at which of the fixed nested-prefix budgets 100, 104, and 108 does exact phase-anchored support first restore all nine three-alias entity classes?
hypothesis: R8's monotone transition continues at four-observation resolution: class fragmentation and split entity triplets will be nonincreasing across 96, 100, 104, 108, and 112 observations per surface, at least one preregistered interior budget will induce exactly nine correct three-member classes with zero split triplets and zero cross-entity collision pairs, and every larger frozen budget will remain restored.

prior_evidence.observation: Across nested prefixes 64, 80, 96, 112, and 128, class counts were 16, 13, 12, 9, and 9; correct triplets were 3, 5, 6, 9, and 9; split triplets were 6, 4, 3, 0, and 0. The first tested restored budget was 112, with no reversal or cross-entity collision.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one dimension from R8: budget resolution inside the qualified 96-failure to 112-restoration interval. Data generation, representation, seeds, entity and family cardinalities, controls, evaluator, and endpoint budgets remain unchanged. It estimates only this deterministic seed panel's four-observation-grid onset and does not claim an exact per-observation onset, a population sample-complexity law, or language competence.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, or CKB-plane authority

arms_and_inputs.underlying_distribution: uniform over context_index 0..15 for every family and entity
arms_and_inputs.nested_prefix_rule: For each entity-family surface, every lower-budget record sequence must equal the same-length prefix of every higher-budget sequence.
arms_and_inputs.representation: R5 exact phase-anchored immediate-context support, selected over the same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs as R8
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: class cardinality, same-entity alias integrity, support coverage, and evaluator-only cross-entity collision pairs

seeds.disjointness: Each entity-family sampler seed is distinct; no matched-seed scientific arm is present; all budgets are nested prefixes of the same per-surface streams.

controls: The 96-observation arm must exactly reproduce R8's 12 classes, six correct triplets, three splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
The 112-observation arm must exactly reproduce R8's nine classes, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
All five arms are nested prefixes generated independently per surface with the frozen R8 seeds and record construction.
Every arm uses the same selected motifs, exact phase-anchored support equality, class induction, and evaluator-only semantic identity.

No family label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, external model, network access, task learner, capacity growth, approximate matching, oracle correction, adaptive budget, or early stopping enters the experiment.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R8 probe reproduces both frozen endpoint controls before R9 scientific output is emitted.
All lower-budget streams exactly match prefixes of the 112-observation streams.
Every surface has exactly its frozen number of records; every context index and byte construction is in range.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, adaptive budget selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.interior_onset_supported: Validity and controls pass; at least one interior arm is fully restored, class and split counts are nonincreasing, restoration never reverses, and interior_first_restored_budget is the smallest restored member of [100,104,108].
classification_rules.endpoint_only_restoration: Validity and controls pass; none of 100, 104, or 108 is fully restored, while 112 is fully restored and all monotonicity conditions pass; interior_first_restored_budget equals 0.
classification_rules.budget_response_falsified: Validity and controls pass, but class count or split-triplet count increases with budget, or a fully restored arm is followed by a non-restored arm.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Either the 96 or 112 R8 endpoint replication fails any frozen exact threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all five frozen arms.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, nested-prefix, sampling, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R8 endpoint replication, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R9 output begins, complete all five arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add budgets, inspect alternate seeds, or alter sampling, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R9 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R9 output.
